LanguageData.BoilTaintedGear.Enabled.Tip: Master switch. While off, the boil bills find no ingredients and sit idle; the bills themselves are kept and work again as soon as this is re-enabled.
LanguageData.BoilTaintedGear.DurabilityCost.Tip: How much durability one boil costs, as a percentage of the item's CURRENT hit points (rounded up). The default is 25%, which lands the average piece of raider gear just above the point where it would lose most of its trade value: cleaned gear stays wearable, keeps roughly half its worth, but is clearly second-hand. Boiling never destroys an item: at most it is left at 1 hp. Applies from the next boiled item on.
LanguageData.BoilTaintedGear.DebugLevel.Tip: Cycles Off / Basic / Verbose.\n\nBasic logs mod loading and every boiled item. Verbose additionally logs per-item durability details and any ingredient that had to be handled the vanilla way instead.
LanguageData.BoilTaintedGear.BehaviorNote: Stoves and campfires offer a "boil tainted gear" bill. It accepts apparel that is currently tainted, cleans it and charges the configured durability cost; the cleaned item is placed next to the fire for a hauler to pick up. Boiling never destroys gear.
